actions.action: Rinse the plant in the shower, spraying leaf undersides and stem sheaths
Swab every white speck with 70% rubbing alcohol on cotton swabs, every 5 days for 4 weeks
Spray insecticidal soap on undersides, stems and base until dripping, every 7 days for 4 weeks
Isolate the plant at least a room away from other plants until no specks for 3 weeks

reason: The answer identifies a sap-sucking insect infestation (mealybugs, close to the confirmed whitefly-type bugs), its core treatment of wiping the bugs off with rubbing alcohol matches the fix that worked, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
